title: Complement-Duality Map for Open Turns
duality: one-edge triples in G are exactly two-edge triples in complement(G)
architecture_upgrade: CCCLXX corrected direct open turns as oriented two-edge triples in G. CCCLXXIV explains the one-edge 4320 count as complement-dual: one-edge triples in G are two-edge triples in complement(G), and orient to all complement-open turns.
theorem: For any triple, edge_count_G + edge_count_complement = 3. Therefore one-edge triples in W33 correspond exactly to two-edge triples in the complement graph. Orienting around the unique middle vertex gives a bijection from one-edge triples of G, with two orientations each, to the open Hashimoto turns of complement(G).
honesty_boundary: This is a complement-dynamics bridge, not the direct W33 Hashimoto open-turn bridge. Direct W33 open turns remain oriented two-edge triples in G.
